_readme: Remote publish targets for the AI-PACS update service (OPT-38).
COPY this file to builder/publish_targets.json and fill in credentials.
publish_targets.json is GITIGNORED — it must never be committed/pushed.
Types: 'ftp' (FTPS by default; set tls=false for plain FTP), 'folder'.
remote_root = the directory that CONTAINS the updates/ tree on the server
(e.g. Hostinger web root 'public_html' -> files land under
auto=true -> build_release.py publishes there automatically after each
with_installer=false keeps the ~600 MB installer OFF the upload; only the
delta store/manifest/feed go up. Upload it explicitly when wanted:
